cases.given: All proposals cannot remain active without recency and attention competition.
cases.expect: A complete comparison built from traceable evidence cards with a bounded live workspace.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a short single source fits comfortably in context
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: Source-boundary and authority rules control what may enter the funnel.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible

cases.given: Pause synthesis when evidence has not been captured with provenance or active pulls cannot be bounded without losing required coverage.
cases.expect: the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
Ten sources and a request for an evidence-grounded decision.
cases.expect: Capture and index evidence in bounded batches before synthesis, then verify the decision against source pointers.
cases.reject: Load all sources and interleave retrieval with unsupported decision writing.
